Rahul Gandhi's Dehradun Event Venue Shifted Amidst Controversy

A planned event for Rahul Gandhi in Dehradun, named 'Chhatron Ki Goonj', was relocated from the Parade Ground after the venue's permission was reportedly revoked. Congress leaders alleged the BJP was 'rattled' and attempted to block the event. Rahul Gandhi also addressed students, calling Prime Minister Modi 'anti-youth' and criticizing alleged police action against students with legitimate demands. Meanwhile, KTR questioned Congress's election assurances, and PM Modi made a veiled remark about a '56-year-old young man'.
